channel.title: Mesa de Grãos
channel.description: O mercado agrícola, explicado com dados.

item.title: Fundos venderam 404 mil contratos de milho. Comerciais compraram 334 mil
item.description: This week's corn data shows why hedge funds and commercial hedgers are almost always on opposite sides: funds sold 404 thousand contracts since late September and flipped net short, while commercials' net position rose 334 thousand. Funds trade the price and commercials trade the grain, and knowing that tells a farmer who is on the other side of every bushel sold.

item.title: Fundos reduzem aposta no boi ao menor nível em quase 3 anos, mas USDA vê boi a $238
item.description: Hedge funds sold live cattle for a second straight week and now hold their smallest bullish bet in almost 3 years, even though USDA, the referee, forecasts less beef and higher fed steer prices. With most of the fund crowd already out and prices firming after the snapshot, the selling looks closer to its end than its start.

item.title: Quem atende o pedido de 115 mi de t de soja da China: Brasil ou EUA?
item.description: China imports 115 million tons of soybeans while growing only 21 million, which makes it the bidder behind the soybean market. Brazil is the biggest seller, yet USDA just raised US soybean exports and cut US stocks, while hedge funds were still trimming a big bullish bet.
